caption: The drawing depicts a single powder horn, primarily brown in color with metallic and wooden elements. The horn is curved and tapers to a narrow, closed spout at one end, which is fitted with a small metallic cap attached by a string. The body of the horn transitions from a natural light brown to dark brown color, appearing polished with visible engraved decorations. Closer to the spout, the horn is fitted with two dark brown or black metal bands that have white ornamentation and rivets, while the broad end is sealed with a circular wooden base featuring a radial pattern and a central metallic knob. Near this broad end, a metal ring is affixed for attachment purposes. The horn sits against a plain light beige background, bordered by a thin single-line rectangular frame. In the upper right corner of the drawing, there is a small inset rectangle containing six small, colored, symbolic or decorative sketches, each spaced equally apart. At the bottom left corner outside the inner frame, there is small, red handwritten text and at the bottom right outside the same frame, the words "SLATE 1" are written.
title: Powder Horn
